chunks: Similar to what is narrated from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) that he said:

The Master of this Command (the Imam) — if he passes away, it is not after forty [years of age] — is the Master of this Command, the strong and energetic one. And similar to this are the reports that have come with differing words and divergent meanings.

key_terms.صَاحِبُ الْأَمْرِ: The Master of the Command, a title for the Imam, specifically the Mahdi

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the age and strength of Imam Mahdi (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Baqir (a.s.) discusses the lifespan of the Imam Mahdi (a.s.), suggesting that his age at death would not exceed forty years, describing him as strong and energetic. It notes that various reports on this topic differ in wording and meaning, indicating a need for careful interpretation of these eschatological traditions.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 396 - It is narrated from Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s)

that the age of Imam Mahdi (a.s) would not be more than forty years. He would be extremely strong, powerful and energetic. There are numerous traditional reports resembling this one, which differ in words as well as meaning.
